critic_summary: The active method (prompt-l1.md) required an empirical pre-check that validated event-class frequency (N=7,535 fires/day for cap=2 paired OPENs — correctly non-vacuous) but had no gate for effect direction. The cap=2 hypothesis produced -96.3% PnL vs base because increasing the position cap from 1 to 2 causes the netting OMS to simultaneously hold opposing LONG and SHORT positions, which cancel each other's alpha rather than compound it. The method's static-artifact count from orders.csv confirmed the branch fires but could not expose this OMS-dynamic failure mode. The proposed method adds a mandatory one-date probe backtest at Step 4 before full implementation: the researcher implements a stub algo, runs it for one median-volume training date, checks both the branch fire count AND the probe-date PnL delta vs base, and aborts if either fails. It also explicitly bans position cap relaxation (any cap > 1) and requires the researcher to explicitly state whether the proposed modification creates simultaneous opposing positions in the netting OMS. If the probe had been run for loop 5, the -96.3% result on that single date would have aborted the hypothesis immediately. On revert: running best is loop 2 (prompt-l1.md), so .current_prompt.md is restored to prompt-l1.md.
